subject.title: Add package changelog previews for plugin publishing

question: Should existing-package changelog previews permanently allow prior-release history reads for direct owners, organization owner/admin/publisher members, moderators, and admins as implemented here?
rationale: The code consistently enforces this boundary and the tests prove it, but repository policy requires maintainer-owned intent for ownership and API trust boundaries rather than deriving permanent authorization policy from implementation alone.

options.title: Approve and specify current boundary
options.body: Keep the implemented access set and add a focused durable spec describing why each role may read prior release history for preview generation.

options.title: Restrict to publishing principals
options.body: Limit history reads to direct owners and authorized organization publishers, excluding platform moderator or admin bypass unless separately justified.

options.title: Pause preview history reads
options.body: Do not merge the existing-package preview path until a different privacy or authorization model is selected.

recommendation.title: Approve and specify current boundary
recommendation.body: Keep the implemented access set and add a focused durable spec describing why each role may read prior release history for preview generation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged scoped-ownership work is the closest current-main provenance for deciding package publishing access.
